flags.message: documents.json's brief-in-opposition entry concatenates two filings under one kind: the Nov 10 2025 cert-stage BIO and the Jul 27 2026 respondents' merits brief (pipe-joined URLs, truncated at 112 pages). Useful content for this merits cell, but the kind label under-describes what the file holds, and a cert-stage consumer of the same file would silently read merits-stage text.
